description: This file implements a utility function `aggregateAgentsUsageAndCost` that aggregates agent costs and usage data from MongoDB collections related to session tracking and language model costs. It processes and merges data from multiple sources, applies filters, normalizes currency and token values, and returns a summarized report with optional pagination.
